verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents a first-party AI agent, Rudder AI, that lets users "manage and interact with your workspace" (docs-11, docs-44), and its homepage mentions AI-powered chat interfaces for analyzing, segmenting and activating data (docs-51). However, the documented agent lives in Slack rather than inside the product's own interface, and there is little detail on which tasks it can actually take on. The RudderStack MCP capabilities run through external clients like Claude or Cursor, so they are not a built-in assistant and are not credited here. Missing for 10: an assistant embedded in the RudderStack app/UI, documentation of the specific tasks it can perform and how, independent or hands-on corroboration.
